integrity: A complete integer minor with determinant -128 and a symbolic index argument prove the finite lattice equality; an exact standalone Python verifier reproduces the determinant and incidence enumeration. No independent review has been performed.
limitations: The theorem concerns the formal integral span of the 60 incidence vectors of genus-two Göpel tetrads in the free group on 16 nodes; it is not a calculation of a Néron–Severi quotient or a characteristic-two Kummer model. Historical equivalence under code-theoretic naming remains possible.
title: The integral Göpel-tetrad lattice of a Kummer quartic
